age_limit.details: The minimum age is 18 and the maximum age is 46, reckoned as on 1 September 2026. Candidates born between 1 September 1980 and 31 August 2008 are eligible to apply. | The notice explains that the Government of Telangana issued an adhoc rule raising the upper age limit from 34 to 46, for a period of 2 years from the date of issue of the Government Order. | The Terms and Conditions also state that for other posts, namely Allied Services, Administrative and Supporting staff, the upper age limit is 45 years, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for BC candidates. The notice prints both limits without saying which of these six posts fall under the 45-year term.

content_sections.heading: About GCN
content_sections.text: Government College of Nursing is a government college in Siddipet, Telangana, and this notification comes from the Office of its Principal. The posts were sanctioned under G.O.Rt.No.1085, Fin (HRM.VII) Dept., dated 29 June 2026. The notice dated 29 October 2026 refers to the Dist. Outsourcing Committee, Siddipet, and is signed by the Asst. Director (Admin), the Principal and the District Collector, Siddipet.

rows.event: Last date of receipt of applications

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: After scrutiny, a provisional list is published, followed by original certificate verification and the final merit list. If a selected candidate does not join within the stipulated time, the next eligible merit candidate will be selected.

rows.component: Experience: contract/outsourcing services rendered in any Government Institutions

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely temporary up to 31.03.2027, or till the vacancies are filled by promotion or regular appointment, or till the actual need ceases, whichever is earlier. This outsourcing placement does not confer any right to future Government appointment. The remuneration is all inclusive and subject to tax deducted at source and any other statutory deductions required under the laws. The selected candidate is eligible for 15 days of leave in a calendar year on cumulative basis as per existing norms. The employee works on a whole-time basis under the administrative control of the institute. The Competent Authority may use the employee's service in any manner required, without any claim for additional remuneration.

faq.question: Q1. Which GCN posts are open to men?
faq.answer: Only the 3 Cleaner posts are open to men. Lab Attendant, Kitchen Personnel, Sanitation Worker, Security Personnel and Dhobi are listed as female only.

faq.question: Q2. Can I apply without experience?
faq.answer: No post in the qualification table can be applied for without experience. Each one requires a minimum of 3 years, and for Lab Attendant it must be laboratory experience.

faq.question: Q3. Which experience earns the 30% weightage?
faq.answer: The 30% marks are added for contract or outsourcing services rendered in any Government Institutions.

faq.question: Q4. What time do applications close on the last day?
faq.answer: The schedule shows 4.00 pm, added by hand beside the date of 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Which certificate does a Lab Attendant applicant need?
faq.answer: The document list asks for an Intermediate, MLT or DMLT certificate, and the applicant must also be registered with the Para Medical Board.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is temporary, and the longest period the notice gives is up to 31.03.2027. It gives no right to a future Government appointment.

faq.question: Q7. Is a QR code needed to apply?
faq.answer: Yes. Forms must be filled through the QR Code, and original certificates must be uploaded the same way. The filled application and xerox copies still have to be submitted at the college.

faq.question: Q8. When will the final merit list come out?
faq.answer: The final merit list is scheduled for 12 November 2026, one day after original certificate verification at Siddipet.
